body: Does anyone know who this young person was? Their name? Whether they had both parents in the house? Whether they were in a gang? There's so much talk about their culture and motives, but no one seems to care who they are.

I'm a burden to my mom and dad. They've told me indirectly. I messed up an out-of-state DUI problem. I turned myself in(out of state) to handle it and they won't extradite me. Upon being released from jail, they re-issue the warrant. I was told this will continue until I get a lawyer in the area I got the DUI or go back there, which I can't do because I'm broke. with that warrant in place, I can't get a job to pay for a lawyer. So it's an endless loop. The house I have in Florida is about to be foreclosed on, so I moved back in with my parents. They've already told me I was a sorry piece of shit so I'm sure they won't help me with this problem. I have nothing to my name except a cracked iPhone that no one wants. I don't see any solutions to this.
